issues.description: Interface name mismatch: The problem statement (and template Main) define and refer to an interface named 'Milkable' with an abstract method messageOnMilk(). In the solution repository the same concept is implemented as an interface named 'Dairy' (Dairy.java defines messageOnMilk()) and Milkable.java is empty. Concrete classes in the solution (Seal, Goat) implement 'Dairy' rather than 'Milkable'. This divergence between the expected interface name ('Milkable') and the solution's name ('Dairy') will confuse students (they will look for/implement Milkable as described) and breaks compatibility with the template Main and any tests that expect Milkable.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the interface name across all artifacts. Preferably rename the solution's 'Dairy' interface to 'Milkable' (move/rename Dairy.java -> Milkable.java and ensure it declares String messageOnMilk()), remove or populate the currently empty Milkable.java, and update Seal.java and Goat.java to implement Milkable. Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to refer to 'Dairy' everywhere — but the less disruptive fix for students is to make the solution match the problem/template by using the name 'Milkable'.
